verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch10.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, comparisons, World Bank country notes)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 2,786 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; Ukraine's unemployment series ends in 2021 and New Zealand's remittances in 2022, both stated on the pages; a stray backslash in the Norway FAQ, an unverified 'more each year' for Peru's remittances and 'pre-war' wording for Ukraine (now 'pre-2022') were corrected before publishing

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
